title: The lost-work check skips named record branches (roadmap and any branch a repo names as its record branch)
why:
The check lists the record branch as a lost-work row every run, though it has no PR and is never merged, so a real row is scrolled past.

11:58 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, relayed; its pick, not owner-typed): lane lost-work-sweep does #3148's conflicts and its own in one pass in #3170 (#3148's lane idle since 19:16 CST Nov 13). Runner 10 closes #3148 as replaced after #3170 merges.

12:05 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 11:59, relayed; its pick, mine, undoable): this step's PR #3322 must be retargeted to the new lost-work-sweep PR; #3148 and #3170 become replaced and runner 10 closes them "Replaced by <new PR>" (main's per-lane merge, d8c16a7711, removed the batch flags #3148 is built on). The lane does the retarget.
source: Lane lost-work-sweep (session_013NEJL1rADjupx82bXheSsB) via the coordinator, 15:29 CST Nov 13.
note: Filed 15:30 CST Nov 13. Small code. State f (merge/merge.py `lost_work_branches`, after PR #3170 merges) lists the record branch `roadmap` (no PR, thousands of commits ahead of main) as a recurring false row. Skip named record branches. Order: test-author red case first (an f row for a no-PR branch that is a named record branch lists no row; an ordinary no-PR branch still lists), then builder, reviewer. Depends on #3170 (head d0a0aaf1b, stacked on #3148). A check change. Past rulings not checked; the lane's reading unread by triage. Coordinator 19:54 CST Nov 13 (19:53, owner asked it to start the lanes): lane started, session_013NEJKzycR77HsAH6WyM2iP (Sonnet, medium; searches for duplicates first). Coordinator relay 17:34 CST Nov 16 (not read by triage 9): coordinator's pick, undoable, not owner-typed: lane lost-work-sweep opens a new branch and draft PR from head 60f5f7b5d and closes PR 3322 as replaced. Reason, lane word 17:33 CST: merge 3322 --review-record refuses every true form because the newest log (comment 6870362451, head 1ac0fbb678) says Rounds 1, 2 and 3 all PASS, which the round rules (roles-review-cap-three: a pass ends review) cannot produce. STALE-DECISION NOTE (not a ruling; for the owner and the consultant, non-blocking): the sentence 'Round 3: reviewer, sonnet, PASS' after a round 2 PASS protected a round count that blocks a restart. Unmeasured whether any rule still needs it. Options: the owner rules the log superseded, or the merge tool's restart check ignores a log that breaks the round rules. The new-PR route removes the block.
